instruction: Star all emails in the Inbox folder

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 1) = (select count(distinct messageID) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 1));

metadata.explanation: Task requires starring all emails in Inbox folder (folderID=1, contains 2 emails based on query). The evaluator checks if star attribute (attributeID=58, value=1) is set for messages in folder 1. Verified from database: folder 1 is INBOX with 2 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL emails in Inbox are starred
Left side counts total emails in Inbox (folderID=1)
Right side counts emails in Inbox that have star attribute (attributeID=58, value=1)
Comparison ensures count of starred emails equals total count of emails
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement to star ALL emails
The postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird to ensure database is flushed before verification
Getter (get_vm_file) can successfully extract the SQLite database from VM
Metric (run_sqlite3) executes the query and returns boolean result correctly

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric run_sqlite3 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
